en.title: Distinct Value Pairs with Difference k
en.description:
Count the distinct ordered value pairs (a,b) in the array such that a+k=b. The same index may serve as both a and b, so when k=0 every distinct value can pair with itself.

The standard I/O and the solution were written independently by this site; ranges marked as this site's are not the original source constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n k (2≤n≤200000, 0≤k≤10⁹), and the second line contains n numbers (0..10⁹).
en.explanation: Example 1: only (1,2); the repeated 1 does not increase the answer, so the result is 1. Example 2: (1,1) and (2,2) are both valid, so the result is 2. Example 3: (1,3), (3,5), (5,7), so the result is 3.
hints: After removing duplicates, check for each a whether a+k exists.
